weather.geojson.zlib.processing: Shapely 2.1.2 simplify(tolerance, preserve_topology=True); tolerance starts at 0.002 degrees and is halved until relative area change <=1%, with actual tolerance recorded per feature. All source polygon components and holes retained before any residual repair. If needed make_valid(method="structure"); non-polygon result or repair relative area change >=1e-6 rejected. No rounding or removed islands; shared boundaries may differ within simplification tolerance.
weather.geojson.zlib.anchor: Interior representative point of largest polygon; not an observation/disaster location.
